protocol.description: Capture sources ext_image_capture_source_v1 doesn't make, captured with ext-image-copy-capture as an output is. Offered on app_server's direct socket only (Olo's own programs: Show on AirPlay).

request.name: create_workspace_source

description.summary: a source for one workspace of a display

request.description: Workspace number `workspace` (from 0) of the display `output`; one past the last there is is captured as the last. While the display shows that workspace, its frames are what the display shows; while it shows another, they are that workspace's windows as they are now, over its desktop, at the display's size and scale.

request.name: create_fitted_source

description.summary: another source, drawn to fit a size

request.description: What `of` shows, drawn smaller where it is larger than `width` x `height` (in buffer pixels), its shape kept, by the compositor as it draws the frame; never larger. A picture made smaller is an even number of pixels each way (what video encoders take). What a video sender would otherwise shrink itself, frame by frame.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Sources made with it are kept.
